evidence_basis: hash-verified frozen candidate and observation ledgers
canonical event, relation, route, and treatment-component observations
review_method_attestation.candidate_review_grain: Each of the 46 manifest candidates was assessed exactly once.
review_method_attestation.observation_review_grain: Each of the 57 manifest observations was accounted exactly once: 46 through one candidate finding and 11 through the frozen preterminal partition.
review_method_attestation.positive_rule: Publication requires exact source-proven route by treatment incidence, an exhaustive application set, and an explicit no-cross-product proof.
review_method_attestation.alias_rule: Duplicate alias requires exact coreference to a named durable frozen candidate target.
review_method_attestation.insufficiency_rule: Insufficient evidence retains the known source facts, states the missing proof, and prohibits route, treatment, realization, or cross-product inference.
review_method_attestation.outside_domain_rule: Outside-domain is used only for a source-proven real event that is non-operational for the route by treatment product.
review_method_attestation.rejection_rule: Rejected requires affirmative source contradiction; absence or prospective wording is never rejection.

preterminal_observation_partition.hash_basis: SHA-256 of RFC 8785-style key-sorted compact JSON for the observations array, followed by one LF.

candidate_partition_verification.hash_basis: SHA-256 of the candidate-id-sorted array of {candidate_id,candidate_key,recommended_disposition,target_candidate_id,observation_event_record_ids}, serialized as key-sorted compact JSON followed by one LF.
candidate_partition_verification.candidate_arithmetic: 0 published + 26 duplicate_alias + 16 insufficient_evidence + 2 outside_domain + 0 rejected + 2 schema_blocked = 46 accounted candidates.
candidate_partition_verification.terminal_nonpublication_arithmetic: 26 duplicate_alias + 16 insufficient_evidence + 2 outside_domain + 0 rejected = 44 terminal nonpublication recommendations; 2 schema blockers remain quarantined.
candidate_partition_verification.observation_arithmetic: 46 candidate-bearing observations + 9 unsupported_record observations + 2 not_episode_evidence observations = 57 accounted observations.

schema_blockers.detail: The pinned retrospective source proves that B44 SBS was implemented in November 2013 with offset/curbside bus lanes, transit signal priority, off-board fare payment, and bus bulbs, but no canonical treatment-component records are materialized from brt_routes_fullreport#p013_c0029..p013_c0030. Borrowing similarly named proposed records from older sources would invent identity equivalence and an application set.

The source proves one B46 historical route surface using the Church Avenue-to-Fillmore Avenue treatment while implementation was underway in August-September 2015, but the canonical date collapses the source range to 2015-09. Publishing that as onset would erase the August-September window; the current reviewed occurrence model has no lossless in-progress interval or installed-by bound for this candidate.
